description: Search transactions by date range and optional filters (condition, action type, payment type, source, email, order id). Read-only.

action_type.description: Comma-separated action types: sale, refund, credit, auth, capture, void, return.

condition.description: Comma-separated transaction conditions: pending, pendingsettlement, in_progress, abandoned, failed, canceled, complete, unknown.

end_date.description: End of range. NMI datetime format YYYYMMDDhhmmss (e.g. 20260101000000 for 2026-01-01 00:00:00).

start_date.description: Start of range. NMI datetime format YYYYMMDDhhmmss (e.g. 20260101000000 for 2026-01-01 00:00:00).

name: search_transactions
